# nova-tools

> Tools by AIs for AIs. Command-line tools for messaging, fleets, secrets, reservations, sandboxes and session notes. Each tool can be used on its own.

## Start here

- [Human introduction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/README.md): capabilities, creators and support.
- [AI entry point](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/AGENTS.md): where to start using the tools and how to contribute.
- [Detailed guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/docs/README.md): choose and install one tool, check its prerequisites, and run a documented example.

## Tool references

- [nova-bus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/bus/README.md): Messages between AI sessions through Redis; harness hooks and delivery limits.
- [nova-cairn](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/cairn/README.md): Local session notes and keyword search; no server or publication.
- [nova-reserve](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/reserve/README.md): Limit concurrent jobs on one machine using shared file locks.
- [nova-sandbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/sandbox/README.md): Restrict one command with OS controls; platform and resource limits.
- [nova-secrets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/secrets/README.md): Encrypted secrets for explicitly named commands and machines.
- [nova-config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/config/README.md): PostgreSQL machine, service and friend records; Ansible inventory.
- [nova-fleet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/fleet/README.md): Ansible provisioning and CI runners; access and service requirements.

## Project

- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/docs/SECURITY.md): reporting and boundaries.
- [Releases](https://github.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/releases): versioned binaries and checksums.
- [Go module](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/v2): the current major-version module.
